San Francisco, CA – July 28, 2026 – Nozomi Networks, the leader in OT, IoT and cyber-physical systems security, today announced that co-founder Andrea Carcano has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, resuming the role he first held when he and co-founder Moreno Carullo launched the company. The appointment marks the start of Nozomi's next phase, one focused on accelerating the AI-driven innovation and technical leadership that have defined the company since its founding. Edgard Capdevielle, who has served as CEO for the past decade, will remain closely involved as an executive advisor to the company.

After a decade leading Nozomi Networks, I'm handing the CEO role to my partner and Nozomi co-founder Andrea Carcano and moving to executive advisor. We got a lot right along the way: past $100M in Revenue and ARR, cash-flow and EBITDA positive, Gartner MQ Leader, Customer Choice, and Company to Beat in AI, a $1B acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric. But the logic here is simple: Leadership in OT and IoT security is becoming leadership in AI, and Andrea is the right person to run that chapter for Nozomi. He and Moreno Carullo built the engine this company started on. Congratulations, Andrea. Nozomi's best chapter starts now.
...
Big news today: Nozomi Networks co-founder Andrea Carcano is returning as CEO. Andrea will return to the role he held when he and Moreno Carullo founded the company 14 years ago with one conviction: industrial systems deserved real security. Edgard Capdevielle, who led Nozomi through the past decade — past $100M in revenue and through its acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric — moves into an executive advisor role. Thank you, Edgard, for everything you built with us. Read more in the press release: https://ow.ly/6VF250ZtGtI

results.author: Moreno Carullo
highlights: Today Nozomi Networks announced that my co-founder, Andrea Carcano, is returning as CEO of Nozomi Networks. Andrea and I started this company in 2013 with one conviction: the industrial world deserved better security than anything that existed. We wrote the first lines of code together. A few years in, we asked Edgard Capdevielle to help us take it to the world - and he did exactly that. A platform trusted by the operators who run critical infrastructure. A company recognized as the leader in its category. A set of milestones very few startups ever reach. Thank you, Edgard. I learned a great deal from you, and I am glad you are staying close to us as an advisor. Now the ground is shifting again. AI is changing how vulnerabilities are found and how defenses are built, faster than anything I have seen in my career. Leading through that will take real research and development depth, not louder marketing. That is why Andrea in this seat is the right decision for the next chapter of Nozomi, and why he has my full support. Two founders, doing what we have always done. The work continues. Back to building.#OTSecurity#IoTSecurity#CriticalInfrastructure#AI

highlights:
Nozomi Networks appoints co-founder Carcano as CEO
...
# Nozomi Networks appoints co-founder Carcano as CEO
...
Nozomi Networks has appointed co-founder Andrea Carcano as Chief Executive Officer, returning him to the role after a decade under Edgard Capdevielle's leadership.
...
Carcano served as Nozomi's original Chief Executive Officer when he and co-founder Moreno Carullo launched the business. The leadership change returns the operational technology, Internet of Things and cyber-physical systems security company to founder-led management.
...
"Edgard has been an extraordinary partner to Moreno and me for the past decade - on behalf of everyone at Nozomi, thank you, Edgard. Stepping into this role feels like returning to where our story began, only now with the conviction of everything we've proven since: category-defining products, the trust of the world's most critical operators, and market leadership recognised across the industry. Moreno and I built Nozomi side by side from the very first lines of code, and side by side is exactly how we'll lead its next chapter. This is a new Day 1 - the same hunger and audacity that started this company, now with everything it takes to win at the largest scale," said Andrea Carcano, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Nozomi Networks.
